description: This file defines a Java interface 'Result' parameterized with a generic type 'E' extending 'Event'. It includes a method for accepting a visitor and a static method to retrieve an empty result, serving as a contract for handling results in persistent actor strategies.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: An interface representing the outcome of applying a strategy to a command, allowing for visitor-based evaluation.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to evaluate the result.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns an empty or default result instance.
